head: Xiaomi 18 Pro and Pro Max UK price: from £1,199, with a rear display
dek: Xiaomi launched the 18 Pro from £1,199 and the 18 Pro Max from £1,399, both with a small second screen on the back. It shows media controls, a live camera view for easier selfies and watch-style faces.
details: The 18 Pro has a 6.4-inch 120Hz screen, a Snapdragon 8 Elite Gen 6 chip, 12GB of memory, a 6,000mAh battery and 90W charging. The 18 Pro Max has a 6.9-inch screen, the Snapdragon 8 Elite Extreme Gen 6, up to 16GB and 1TB, a 7,050mAh battery and 100W charging. Both have three Leica cameras (200MP main, 200MP periscope zoom, 50MP ultra-wide) and Xiaomi's new privacy display on the front screen. Colours are black, white, Velvet Red and Cosmic Blue; Xiaomi skipped the 17 Pro models in the West last year.
where: UK prices announced 17 November; other countries and sale dates not given
means: If you're choosing a new Android phone in the UK, Xiaomi now sells two models with a screen on the back, from £1,199.
todo: Nothing to do unless you're buying. Check UK stores for stock and compare storage options, as £1,399 is the 256GB Pro Max.
thumb_words: XIAOMI 18 PRO: SCREEN ON THE BACK
